summary: Backend verification of P1a Measurement Record fixes (role placeholder, duplicate sign-off, long-form dates, DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM). Wrote pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_measurement_record_signoff.py covering all 5 assertions. Each generate assertion runs TWICE against Claude to catch LLM drift. All 9 tests PASSED (2 runs x 4 LLM assertions + 1 scrubber inspection).

minor.issue: One of the two LLM runs added an extra 'REVIEW DATE: 07/09/2027' line in the document header. Measurement Record is a daily site record so a REVIEW DATE line should probably be suppressed for this tool (add measurement-record to the suppress_auto_review set / SINGLE_SIGNOFF_TOOLS review-date-suppression list). Not part of the 5 requested assertions but worth fixing for consistency.

evidence.bug1_role_empty: With signatureRole='' the CONTRACTOR SIGN-OFF block contained only: Name / Company / Date and time / Signature — no 'Role:' line, no '(role not set in profile)' placeholder. Both runs clean.
evidence.bug2_role_director:
Sample sign-off (verbatim): 'CONTRACTOR SIGN-OFF
Name: Darren Morris
Role: Director
Company: Test Co Ltd
Date and time: 07/09/2026 18:37
Signature: ...' — appears exactly once.
evidence.bug3_single_signoff: Only ONE 'CONTRACTOR SIGN-OFF' block per document across all 8 LLM runs. No standalone 'MEASURED BY' heading. Factual 'Measured by: Darren Morris' line correctly present inside RECORD DETAILS with no Signature/Date panel.
evidence.bug4_dates: All dates numeric: 'Date measured: 15/01/2026', header 'DATE: 07/09/2026', sign-off 'Date and time: 07/09/2026 18:37'. No long-form UK dates observed in any of 8 runs.
evidence.bug5_scrubber: scrubContent in /app/frontend/src/lib/pdf.js exports properly: strips '(role not set in profile)' + '[SIGNATORY ROLE]/[Role]/[insert role]', drops empty 'Role:' lines (regex /^\s*Role\s*:\s*$/i), converts 'DD Month YYYY' -> 'DD/MM/YYYY'. Verified by regex: matches '07 September 2026', does NOT match '2026-01-15' (ISO) or '07/09/2026' (numeric).

action_items: Optional: add 'measurement-record' to the review-date-suppression set on the backend so 'REVIEW DATE' does not sporadically appear in the header (observed 1 of 2 runs).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1733 lines — should be split into modules (auth, generate, jobs, cis, team, drafts).
_signoff_instructions() now correctly omits Role line when role is empty (line ~382).
GLOBAL FORMATTING RULES block (lines 778-781) is well-worded and enforces DD/MM/YYYY + placeholder ban + sign-off uniqueness at the prompt layer.
Frontend scrubContent() is a good defensive belt-and-braces — long-date regex correctly avoids ISO/numeric false positives.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 tests, all 5 bug fixes verified across 2 LLM runs each)

test_credentials: darrenhustle300 / hustle1234 (admin). Original signatureRole snapshot captured and restored in module-scoped fixture teardown.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_measurement_record_signoff.py can be reused as a regression suite for any future prompt/LLM changes to the sign-off block or global formatting rules. It runs each assertion twice to cope with LLM non-determinism. Only minor drift observed was a sporadic REVIEW DATE line in the header of measurement-record (probably measurement-record is not in the suppress_auto_review list yet).
